notes.title: Announcement for the Update
notes.notes:
Hello,

New version of Sacred Stones with the update will be uploaded on 23 December 2019.

The new version has added a choice of difficulty levels for the players unfamiliar with action games. 

In addition, unfortunately, we will not support on Linux platform since 23 December 2019. 
We ask for your understanding.


We appreciate all your support!

notes.title: Android version was released!
notes.notes:
Introducing the mobile version of Sacred Stones :)

It's currently being put on the Android version, and the iOS version is being briefed by domestic law ( ...)

The game content is the same as the Steam version and the controls have been modified to match the mobile.

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.noxbix.sacredstonesmobile]Google Play Store[/url]

notes.title: You can play Sacred Stones now on OS X too!
notes.notes:
Many Mac users have also asked for Mac release of this game. 

There have been some technically unsolved problems that prevented the release of Mac versions. We have put a lot of effort into solving the problem.

And finally, today, we're finally releasing the Mac version.
I hope Mac users enjoy our games as well.

Adding new features or ideas is always welcome.

Thank you!

notes.title: Patch Note ver. 1.2.5
notes.notes:
New patch 1.2.5.

- Map Move Bug fixed
- Some wrong spell fixed
- Desert Item bug fixed
- Red key shield bug fixed
- Last boss's door bug fixed
- Remove experience decimal points
- some small bugs fixed

We're developing a mobile version now. So are the versions of OSX, Linux :)

notes.title: About Sacred Stones OST
notes.notes:
Sacred Stones OST has been released as DLC. 

As you can see, this OST is almost a separate record, not a sound recording in the game. 
(Of course, a lot of motifs from the melody of the game.) 

This record is a regular record that goes up to each streaming site.

But it's cheaper to buy with DLC :)

This is a sample song : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rD1OJtTH4G0

notes.title: Almost ready!
notes.notes:
There have been many changes to the game system.
The shield system has been improved and experience has been gained.
You can increase your shield by stacking experience points.

Steam achievement has been added.
The official release is getting closer :)

notes.title: Patch Note (v 1.0.8) and Good News!
notes.notes:
Hello,

[h1][b]We'd released v 1.0.8 [/b][/h1]

- The final boss stage has been modified.
  : effects
  : attack method
  : map structure

- Modify how to get last stage jump item( triple jump )
- Add item to last stage
- Some bosses's hp is changed


[h1][b]And Good News[/b][/h1]
We've been accepted to appear and showcase [url=https://dreamhack.com/austin]  @ DreamHack Austin[/url] from June 1st-3rd in Indie Playground with a FREE booth in the "Best Action" category! 




See you there~!

notes.title: Introduce our OST
notes.notes:
Sacred Stones has a really beautiful OST. 
We have completely remake these songs and have created them for music appreciation.

All 16 songs and the total play time is 40 minutes.

Three of them will be released as samples. Please enjoy.


[url=https://soundcloud.com/user-726836767/sets/sacred-stones-ost-sample/s-OVfzM] Sacred Stones OST Sample[/url]
